entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I received about a month ago. It's for the Aero Road Helmet.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the details?
Sure, the name is Alex Carter, and the order number is VF78122.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the Aero Road Helmet in Solar Flare Yellow. What specifically is the issue with it?
There's no real issue, it's a great helmet. It's just that the color is a bit brighter than I expected. The box is still unopened, and I was hoping to return it for a different shade.
I understand completely. Sometimes the color on screen can be different. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment, please.
Okay, Alex, thanks for waiting. I see here that the delivery was 29 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can absolutely approve that return for you.

That's fantastic, thank you. Now, since I am a long-time customer and the box is unopened, is there any possibility of getting a small credit or a discount code for my next order? I'll be re-ordering the same helmet in black.

That's a reasonable request, Alex. I see you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble of having to send it back, I can definitely offer you a 15% discount code for your next purchase. We want to ensure you're happy with your gear and that your safety is never compromised by a poor fit or a distracting color.
A 15% discount sounds perfect. That's very helpful, I appreciate you working with me on this.

Of course. I've just sent the prepaid return label and the discount code to the email on your account. Just pack the helmet back up, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed once we receive it. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been great, Diana.
My pleasure, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day!
